Veterans Day is more than a date on the calendar. It is an opportunity to recognize the courage and sacrifice of the millions of brave Americans who defended our freedoms and protected the principles upon which this nation was founded.
 
To every veteran in the 12th District of Georgia and across the country: Thank you. Thank you for your bravery, your patriotism, and your willingness to put service above self. God Bless our veterans and God Bless the United States of America.
Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan, @GOPMajorityWhip, @RepLisaMcClain, and @RepBrianJack—our House Republican Leadership team for the 120th Congress. 🇺🇸

For 251 years, the @USMC has stood on the font lines of freedom, answering the call to defend our nation.

Here's to the generations of Marines who have demonstrated unmatched courage strength, and dedication. Today, we honor their legacy and celebrate those who continue to https://t.co/91F6QdlUaP

Demand for disaster programs, including the Emergency Forest Restoration Program (EFRP), have increased substantially in recent years due to large disaster events, particularly in Georgia.

Congress must ensure additional funding for landowners relying on EFRP to complete https://t.co/8ilJgRHU2i
Happy Halloween from our trick-or-treaters to yours! 🎃👻 https://t.co/1gmnkAUx2j

Time to get the PBM Kickback Prohibition Act across the finish line! Thank you, @USDOL for finalizing a commonsense rule that exposes PBM's harmful tactics that deceptively raise Americans' costs. https://t.co/DYxSh4yMPW

Fantastic tour of @statesborofire's new Station 3, which officially opened last month. After nearly two decades of planning, it is great to see Station 3 officially open and providing expanded fire protection across Statesboro. God bless our firefighters in GA-12! https://t.co/JRnx0pwaPW

SIGNED INTO LAW: The bipartisan, bicameral Retire through Ownership Act

I was proud to lead this bill during the 119th Congress to increase employee ownership and to promote a secure and prosperous retirement for hardworking Americans.

Read more:
https://t.co/pUOXgiUNAa https://t.co/Vlbu5wD32g

Every two years, I am blown away by the young leaders from across the 12th District who choose to participate in our Youth Leadership Summit.

"If your actions inspire others to dream more, learn more, do more, and become more, you are a leader.” –John Adams https://t.co/b4N2v0mvyn

Happy Birthday to the @USNavy! For 251 years, our Sailors have defended our seas, protected our freedoms, and projected American strength around the world.

Today, we honor their service, sacrifice, and unwavering commitment to our nation. https://t.co/1Y9NUz7j0z

Several counties in the 12th District are expected to feel the impacts of Hurricane Isaias throughout the weekend, including scattered, widespread rain, flooding, and potential wind gusts up to 40 mph.

Stay weather aware, stay safe, and stay informed through local news and weather updates.

Great to welcome @SBA_Kelly back to the 12th District yesterday! ShaloTek in Statesboro is a great example of the innovative manufacturers and job creators we have here in rural Georgia. 

As one of only seven winners of the first-ever Critical Suppliers Prize Competition hosted by @SBAgov, ShaloTek has positioned itself well for future growth, expansion, and job creation.

Gone are the days of outsourcing our energy needs. @POTUS and @HouseGOP have reclaimed American energy dominance.

Energy security = national security https://t.co/CuuO9b0uTU

American companies like Club Car and E-Z-GO, both located in GA-12, should be able to outcompete based on the quality, innovation and value of what they produce — not against foreign governments willing to subsidize competitors and distort prices.

Ahead of President Xi's visit to the @WhiteHouse, read my op-ed in @FoxNewsOpinion about what the golf cart industry can teach us about China’s threat to American jobs: https://t.co/na5rQic6Si

Wishing all who observe this sacred day a meaningful Yom Kippur filled with peace, hope, and reflection.

May your fast bring renewed strength and purpose in the year ahead.
The Georgia Memorial Veterans Cemetery is coming to Augusta! https://t.co/yRlqMVcw47

☑️ Headed to the President's Desk: The Retire through Ownership Act

I was proud to lead this bipartisan, bicameral legislation that will help eliminate the regulatory ambiguity and unnecessary risks ESOPs often face.

This commonsense bill will ensure more Americans can enjoy a secure retirement!

The funding for the long-awaited veterans cemetery in Augusta has now been officially awarded to the State of Georgia!

To our veterans and their families in the CSRA and surrounding communities: the tireless work that brought us to this point is for you.

https://t.co/AnkmtYXayh https://t.co/pqjUAVpfAB

I was honored to join the community in Columbia County this morning to remember those we lost on that heart-wrenching day 25 years ago which is forever etched in our history.

Our thoughts and prayers remain with the victims and all of those impacted on September 11, 2001. https://t.co/XmQpz3sZHF

On this day 25 years ago, evil breached our shores and our nation would be forever changed. Thousands of Americans said goodbye to their loved ones not knowing it would be their last. 

Today, we remember the lives of those who died on September 11, 2001 from terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center in New York City, the Pentagon in Virginia, on United Airlines Flight 93 which crashed in rural Pennsylvania, and the first responders who charged toward the chaos as others fled to safety.

We will never forget.

One year ago today, we lost Charlie Kirk—a devoted husband, father, and man of faith—to an unspeakable act of political violence. We will always remember and uphold Charlie's mission to ensure America lives up to its founding principles.

May God continue to grant comfort to his wife, Erika, his children, his family, and all who loved him.

Last week, I was honored to deliver a speech on the House floor to recognize John "Jack" Welsh—an American patriot and World War II combat veteran who celebrated his 100th birthday on Friday, September 4, 2026.

I spent a little time with Jack on his birthday and presented him with a signed copy of the Congressional Record. When we speak of the Greatest Generation, we’re speaking of decorated American heroes like Jack Welsh. Happy birthday, Sir!

https://t.co/wauPqqPIRl

As we celebrate Labor Day, I hope you will join me in honoring America's resilient workforce—the hardworking men and women who keep our communities growing, our economy moving, and our nation thriving. 

Thank you for all you do to build a stronger America! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/u01g1OP2Mk

Powerful testimony from Marcus Coleman earlier this week. 

We have long warned that illegal sanctuary city policies have dire consequences.

In this case, an innocent 5-year-old was permanently disabled. Life changed forever. 

“My daughter doesn't deserve this...every day, something is happening to somebody, and it is your guys’ fault. I hold each and every one of you responsible for it, and I always will."

The Rural Health Transformation (RHT) Program is changing the game for rural hospitals and providers across the country.

$219 million for rural Georgia means hardworking Georgians will feel the benefits of expanded access to quality care. https://t.co/fqAXsTn7wM

Denouncing socialism should be a no-brainer. But not for today’s Democratic Party. 192 House Democrats just refused to do so.
 
Socialism replaces freedom with control, ownership with dependence, and equal rights with forced outcomes.
 
It replaces the American Dream with a government permission slip.
 
This is one of the more frightening votes I’ve witnessed on the House floor. Truly shocking.

RESULTS, not rhetoric.

⬇️ Fentanyl-linked deaths plunge 22%

📉 LARGEST reduction in violent crime in American history

💊 Prescription drugs prices just saw their sharpest drop in 60 YEARS https://t.co/04qw8yT7yR

It was great to once again join the annual Toombs, Tattnall, and Evans County Farm Bureau legislative dinner—hosted this year by Toombs County in Lyons.

I provided an update on the House-passed Farm Bill. The best way to reinvigorate our farm economy and bring certainty back to rural America is to send a modern Farm Bill that addresses today's challenges to President Trump's desk.

I was proud to support the Working Families Tax Cuts which made this historic investment in rural Georgia possible.

This $93.3 million federal investment will help expand coordinated statewide care, strengthen the rural health workforce, and support technology-enabled healthcare access across Georgia.

Five years ago today, 13 brave American service members were killed in the Abbey Gate attack in Afghanistan.

We remember their courage, honor their sacrifice, and keep their families and loved ones in our prayers. We will never forget. https://t.co/yOGiLeV87I
.@HouseGOP and the Trump Administration will continue our work to secure the border and root out the illegal sanctuary city policies that put American lives at risk. https://t.co/TDt6j3qNb4

New York City's sanctuary city policies failed Laken Riley.

"One thing I felt sure of is that I did my job, yet Laken’s life was taken because someone failed to do theirs."

Must read from Ethan Curreri, a former New York City police officer: https://t.co/k3X1HsoSmF https://t.co/vFsS2BJWfr

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Retire through Ownership Act (S 2403)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill lets an employee stock-ownership plan rely on an independent appraiser's value for company stock that is not publicly traded, if the appraiser follows Internal Revenue Service methods. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.
